scope: Forensic/read-only inventory of the 17 non-replay-ready cities. No alert/evidence/classifier/QA/baseline/production/campaign repair is performed.

corpus_model.canonical_episode_id_rule: sha256(city_key + '|' + UTC alert_start + '|' + UTC alert_end)[:24], but only after final production interval union; IDs were not synthesized from partial inputs.
corpus_model.retained_primary_count_rule: Count retained Alerts.in.ua start/end rows inside missing blocks, plus only UkraineAlarm rows proven non-overlapping with the counted static-row envelope. Overlapping API rows are not double-counted.

exact_upstream_snapshot_reference.probe_result: GitHub blob lookup in this repository returned 404; the hash is provenance, not retained content.

evidence_model.replay_grade_rule: Current replay requires city final_evidence.json; summary counts/dates alone are insufficient for current-classifier replay.
evidence_model.zhytomyr_note: working_evidence.json is retained with status=complete, denominator=685, strict=19, sensitivity=20, qa.remaining=[]; because it is not replay-accepted final_evidence.json it is classified PARTIAL, not NO.

findings: No branch tree contained additional missing-city canonical alert slices beyond the current multicity base.
Likely missing slice paths such as chernihiv-P2a, dnipro-P2a, kharkiv-P1a, mykolaiv-P1a, odesa-P3a and kherson-P1a have no commit history on the multicity lineage.
The initial source-slice build commit created only the slices still present for these 17 cities; later commits add other/repair city slices, not the missing blocks.
No deleted final_evidence history was found for chernivtsi, ivano_frankivsk, khmelnytskyi, lutsk, poltava, rivne, ternopil, uzhhorod or vinnytsia.
Zhytomyr history contains only working_evidence.json; no final_evidence.json was found.
